key.name: delete-action
key.summary: Delete action of the desktop context menu
key.description: What the delete entry in the icon context menu does: "delete" removes the item permanently (after a confirmation), "trash" moves it to the trash.

key.name: context-menu-hidden
key.description: Entry ids that are left out of the icon context menu. Known ids: open-with, terminal, rename.

key.name: arrange
key.description: "grid": icons can be dragged and snap into grid cells, "free": icons stay exactly where dropped, "auto": icons arrange themselves in sorted order.

key.name: sort-by
key.description: Order used for automatic arrangement and when sorting the desktop.
